name: Trips - Right - 58 Sweep

X.rule: Stay down in your stance — no motion. At the snap run flat behind the quarterback, take the handoff at full speed and get to the right edge. Turn up outside the trips.

QB.rule: Open right and hand the ball to the left tight end as he comes across behind you, then fake a run to the left.

coaching_points: No motion before the snap. The end stays down in his stance.
He turns up outside the trips. The fullback takes the force man; the slot screens.
